name: ERDASAN
recent: ERDASAN 于 2026 年 8 月 28 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。2026 年 10 月 31 日，Datin Ong Poh Lin Abdullah 的董事会成员变动。2026 年 11 月 14 日及 17 日，公司分别发布「其他」类公告。
notable: Datin Ong Poh Lin Abdullah 出现董事会成员变动。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026
Change in Boardroom - DATIN ONG POH LIN ABDULLAH

recent_en: ERDASAN released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 on 28 August 2026. On 31 October 2026, there was a change in boardroom involving Datin Ong Poh Lin Abdullah. The company issued 'Others' announcements on 14 and 17 November 2026.
notable_en: Change in boardroom involving Datin Ong Poh Lin Abdullah.
